scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @salon/api" "npm run worker:dev -w @salon/api" "npm run dev -w @salon/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @salon/shared && npm run build -w @salon/api && npm run build -w @salon/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @salon/shared && npm run typecheck -w @salon/api && npm run typecheck -w @salon/web && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test -w @salon/shared && npm run test -w @salon/api
